dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetrical with no visible localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Consistent medium-grey slate tone across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle longitudinal indentation visible along the central dorsal axis posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, thin, light-colored longitudinal linear mark is visible along the posterior dorsal midline.
other_distinctive_markers: Centrally located, dark elliptical blowhole at the anterior portion of the dorsal plane.
